Former DR Congo President Kabila Forms Alliance with M23 Rebels

Former DR Congo president Joseph Kabila announced on Monday the formation of a new political and military coalition of groups opposing the current government. This alliance includes the M23 rebels, who have seized significant territory in eastern Congo. Kabila was sentenced to death in absentia for alleged complicity with the M23 group.
